product.olivetti-notebook-s20.summary: The S20 in the 2.5 kg notebook format, with a 60 MB disk.
product.olivetti-notebook-s20.history: In September 1991 Olivetti offered the Notebook S20 in the Olivetti 1. line. The Historical Archive attributes development of the range to Triumph-Adler with Y-E Data collaboration and locates production in Nuremberg.
product.olivetti-notebook-s20.architectu: The format explains the differences in weight and expansion. The catalogue specifies 2.5 kg and 297 × 210 × 52 mm, with an integrated mouse and 1.44 MB floppy drive.
product.olivetti-notebook-s20.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-notebook-s20.limitation: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-notebook-s20.catalogue: Olivetti, La gamma dei personal computer professionali, 3905621C-00, 9/91, p. 3.
